title: Grateful Dead Live at Electric Theater on 1969-07-05

ai_review.summary: Muddy 1969 soundboard capture of a raw, jam‑heavy night featuring a soaring Dark Star and marathon Lovelight despite hiss and tape wobble.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised for its energetic jams – especially the extended Dark Star, St. Stephen, The Eleven and a 35‑minute Lovelight that closes the show – but the soundboard tape suffers from noticeable mud, tape hiss and occasional wobble that mask some details. While the mix is respectable for a 1969 recording, listeners will need to tolerate or EQ out the hiss to enjoy the band’s raw power, which is occasionally marred by Jerry’s sloppy phrasing on a few tunes.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers highlight strong musical moments (Dark Star, Lovelight, China Cat) giving the show a high rating, but many note significant recording flaws that pull the overall enjoyment down; weighted average yields ~3.6/5.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Tape is muddy with prominent hiss and occasional wobble/distortion (e.g., vocal distortion on Momma Tried, unlistenable Baby Blue for some). Stereo mix is decent for 1969 but requires EQ to tame high‑end noise.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The first half opens strong with tight Lovelight and Baby Blue, then launches into deep jams on Dark Star and St. Stephen. The middle sees a rougher China Cat/High Time transition, while the finale delivers an epic 35‑minute Lovelight that caps the night.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Shows raw power in Dark Star but sounds out of sorts on St. Stephen and The Eleven, flubbing or eliding key phrases.
